issues.evidence: AOv13.tsx: a single sfx/roomtone.wav loop for the whole film, with only gain steps (0.4 / 0.55 / 0.3). The night office, the 9:02 AM boardroom (f_31, glass and skyline), the dawn wide and the end card share the same air.
issues.suggested_action: Build 3 beds: night office (HVAC hum and distant sirens or traffic, -42 dBFS), dawn (early traffic and a bird, -40), boardroom (larger room air, a distant phone and HVAC, -40). Crossfade them on the 70.3 and 73.3 cuts (J-cut 0.5 s early).

issues.evidence: The candidate claims 'room tone only'. Measured: 28.75 = -15.8, 29.0 = -19.2, 29.25 = -23.7 dBFS; 94% of energy is below 250 Hz (peak 36 Hz). It is the mixkit_498 impact accent placed on the 28.8 cut. Real quiet lasts only ~0.6 s (29.5-30.1, -29 to -46) before the riser starts at 30.1.
issues.suggested_action: Remove the 498 accent at 28.8 (the heartbeat at 25.4 already did the punch), let her face sit 1.5 s on room tone plus an audible breath at about -32 dBFS, and start the riser at 30.4.

issues.evidence: -44.2 and -49.5 dBFS just before the 31.3 impact. Not digital silence, but room tone at 0.55 is masked by nothing, so it reads as a dropout because the riser has died.
issues.suggested_action: Hold room tone plus the riser tail through to the hit, or make the suck-out deliberate and ≤150 ms.

issues.evidence: Top-down phone desk and the tight face close-up share the same room-tone gain (0.4); buzz.wav sits at the same 0.7 on both texts with no desk resonance. The step at the 11.2 cut is -6.7 dB with no change of space.
issues.suggested_action: Make the buzz a desk-rattle (wooden surface) for the top-down shot; on the face close-up, high-pass the room by 150 Hz and drop it 3 dB for intimacy.

issues.evidence: Real-app diffs shown 'on her laptop' (45.8, OnScreen m01_ots) vs floating InSpace panels get identical treatment; there is no laptop-fan or room cue when we are back in her office.
issues.suggested_action: Under OnScreen laptop shots, bring the night-office bed up 2 dB with a faint laptop fan; under the abstract InSpace panels, let the score own the space.

issues.evidence: Tail 80-82.3 at -28.8 RMS; the boardroom air does not carry under the end card.
issues.suggested_action: L-cut the boardroom bed 1 s into the end card, then fade.

layers: faint laptop fan on close shots
same office bed -3 dB, HPF 150 Hz
large room air with short reverb
boardroom air L-cut 1 s then out

constraint_failures.rule: location change with no ambience change
constraint_failures.evidence: Night office → dawn → boardroom all use the one roomtone.wav loop at gain 0.3.

top_revision: Replace the single room-tone loop with distinct night-office, dawn and boardroom beds J-cut across 70.3 and 73.3, and make 28.8-30.4 real silence (cut the 498 impact accent; room tone plus breath only).
